summary: The diff implements String.prototype.includes steps 1-12 in order. RequireObjectCoercible, ToString(this), IsRegExp(searchString), the TypeError on a RegExp, ToString(searchString), then ToIntegerOrInfinity(position) with clamping all run in spec order, and every abrupt completion propagates with `?`. The private helper string_index_of follows StringIndexOf steps 1-5, including the empty-search and fromIndex cases and the empty-range case when searchLength > length. Nothing is special-cased, hardcoded or swallowed. The only cosmetic deviation is that the spec NOTE comments from the stub were removed. The gate report shows build, clippy and test262 all clean.
